subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers repair this stale branch, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or preserve the idea in a replacement PR against current main?
rationale: The branch still contains merge-blocking protocol/session/restart issues and missing real proof, but it is paired with an open bug and contains useful behavior that may be worth adopting.

options.title: Rebase and reshape before review
options.body: Update the branch to current main's packages/gateway-protocol and Gateway/Control UI lifecycle owners, then require real Dashboard proof before merge.

options.title: Use as replacement source
options.body: Open or adopt a narrower maintainer-owned replacement if the current branch is too stale to repair cleanly while preserving attribution.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmergeable until maintainers decide whether the remaining behavior belongs in this branch or a newer canonical fix path.
